standard_prerequisites.name: Representable morphisms from decent spaces
standard_prerequisites.use: Ensures intermediate spaces Z_j are decent algebraic spaces so blowing up is defined.

standard_prerequisites.name: Fibres under the etale neighbourhood correspondence
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the closed point z_1 of the fibre over x_1 with a closed point z_{1,1} of (Z_{1,1})_{u_1}.

core_obligations: A blowing up is representable, so inductively each Z_j -> X (resp. Z_{i,j} -> U_i) is representable and the intermediate spaces are decent; this makes the assertions meaningful.

Forward direction: start from Z_m -> ... -> Z_0 = X; the first step blows up some x_i, say x_1; applying the functor F to Z_1 -> X produces a blowup Z_{1,1} -> U_1 at u_1 with Z_{i,0} = U_i for i > 1.

At the next step either blow up one of x_2, ..., x_n on Z_1, or pick a closed point z_1 of the fibre over x_1 and transport it via the fibre isomorphism to a closed point z_{1,1} of Z_{1,1}; set Z_{1,2} -> Z_{1,1} to be the blowup at z_{1,1}; continue inductively to build the factorizations of all g_i.
Converse direction: given sequences on the U_i, construct the sequence of blowups of X by the same transport of closed points through the fibre isomorphisms.
proof_roadmap: Representability and decency bootstrap; functor F applied to the first blowup; closed-point transport through fibre isomorphisms; inductive continuation; converse by the same transport.
difficulty_reason: A two-sided construction whose substantive step is transporting closed points of fibres through the isomorphism of the fibre lemma to keep the sequences in step.
